measurementMethod.axis: Read depth against labelled cm scale; infer diameter from equal horizontal/vertical drawing scale. This is a chart assumption, not metrology.
measurementMethod.uncertainty: Broad envelopereading ±1–3cm. Overlappinglobes, dot pattern, blur and absent independentverticalscale preventsubmillimeterfitclaims.
measurementMethod.fitPolicy: Fit only values that have verified dimensions. Zero error to an estimated target is calibration, not independent validation. Do not fill nulls with invented source numbers.
measurementMethod.sourceDataOnly: This file is input evidence. Runtime Cd,k,yaw span,fragmentthreshold/shape and fitted prediction outputs belong to runtime ledger/QA, not silently to these source observations.

profiles.yawOnsetSource: EWS2004 p1.8 text; diagram onset is diffuse≈.05–.07m
profiles.yawBehavior: Nondeforming pointed projectile ends base-forward; two lobes are visible. A single90°plateau is an approximation and must be reported if second lobe is absent.
profiles.registryDifferences: Chart says53gr3.4g; game7N6 mass3.43g and nominal890m/s. Use chart speed/mass only in calibration; preserve registry mass/flight in gameplay.

profiles.yawBehavior: Yaw≈90°,flatten,break at cannelure after≈12cm; fragments plotted around central path; fragment radius is an envelope reading, not uniform irreversible destruction.
profiles.registryDifferences: Chart3.6g; game3.56g. Axis in reduced EWS reproduction ends35cm, original FacklerFig2 explicitly36cm.

profiles.uncertaintyPolicy: Retain donor uncertainties, plus unknown structural/model discrepancy. Do not present as a measured M855 curve.
profiles.registryDifferences: M85562gr/4.02g in game has a steel penetrator and different geometry from lead-core M19355gr3.6g. EWS only says similar pattern; use actual M855 mass/caliber in gameplay, not donor mass.

Chart identifies AK47FMJ120.5gr7.89g but not country/lot/core structure. RegistryPS57-N-2317.9g is nearest-name/caliber approximation; steel-core equivalence has not been established. Other Yugoslav/lead-core lots may yaw earlier.

profiles.yawBehavior: 90°at≈28cm, then base-forward; no fragmentation in illustrated gelatin shot.
profiles.registryDifferences: Plot9.7g150gr, gameM809.5g. EWSaxisends65cm; originalFacklerFig3ends64cm; calibration uses64cm.

profiles.limits: This is NOT a complete Fackler gelatin profile. Organ/gel composite shots all perforated30cm; no numeric total depth, yaw onset, maximumTCdiameter, or fragmentation threshold. Numeric pistol model inputs remain estimated tuning, and no gelatin pass may be claimed against unavailable reference dimensions.

tissueCoefficientEvidence.sourceSupportedOrder: Lung/muscle/bowel/vessels tolerate stretch better than solid liver/spleen/kidney; precise lung<muscle ordering and brain=1 are game design.

densityEvidence.limits: Select homogeneous gelatin density/Cd as tuning if no measuredsource used; muscle reference density does not determine Cd.

verified: EWS2004 p1.8 describes yaw/deformation/cannelure breakup at 943m/s and says M855 pattern is similar.
Fackler1987 Figure2 proves substantial fragmentation for M193 at943m/s.
notVerified: A primary literature boundary separating fragment/no-fragment at823m/s or762m/s.
A lot-invariant or entry-yaw-invariant universal threshold.
fragmentationThresholdReview.implementationPolicy: Use original registry terminalEffect.thresholdVelocity values (M193780m/s,M855760m/s) as S1 fragmentation-threshold tuning borrowed from a differently purposed original value. No primary-paper fragmentation threshold was verified. Preserve the original registry and flight behavior; record this semantic change in the3D ledger.
searchFailures: Current EWS2018 and original Fackler1987 do not state the requested numeric threshold.
